action_instruction: Reading the download size from the Download status message
intent: the download size in KB from the Download status message

action_params.condition: The Download status message includes a size in KB greater than zero (it reads "1.8 KB, 1855 bytes").
action_params.query: the download size in KB from the Download status message

action_instruction: Checking the PDF validity sentence in the Download status message
intent: whether the Download status message includes the PDF validity sentence

action_params.condition: The Download status message includes the sentence "The file is a valid, non-empty PDF.".
action_params.query: whether the Download status message includes the PDF validity sentence
action_params.code_js: el(32).textContent.includes('The file is a valid, non-empty PDF.')

action_instruction: Reading the downloaded file entry from the file list
intent: the downloaded filename and byte size shown in the file list

action_params.query: the downloaded filename and byte size shown in the file list

assertion_tree.description: The Download status message includes a size in KB greater than zero (it reads "1.8 KB, 1855 bytes") and the sentence "The file is a valid, non-empty PDF.", and the list below shows "chaise-statement-2026-08.pdf · 1855 bytes".

sub_results.description: The Download status message includes a size in KB greater than zero (it reads "1.8 KB, 1855 bytes").
The Download status message includes the sentence "The file is a valid, non-empty PDF.".

assertion_tree.verification: The current page shows the specified Download status message details and the specified file entry in the list below.
